post.title: Low-Level Design: Designing a Vending Machine using the State Pattern
post.subtitle: Build a robust, state-driven vending machine system in Java Boot with clean OOP design.
post.brief: Designing a Vending Machine is a classic low-level design interview problem that tests state-driven logic. By using the GoF State Pattern, we avoid nested conditional blocks and build a modular, thread-safe system in Java Spring Boot.
